note: Verify pass 2026-09-11. passcheck had only one Wikidata lead (an Anne Frank sapling, not chased) and no register. Found the naming body: City of Pittsburgh Shade Tree Commission's 'Remarkable Trees of Pittsburgh' program (partnership with Tree Pittsburgh), confirmed via official meeting minutes (a real government PDF). remarkabletreespgh.com itself, which almost certainly has the full designated list with better detail and photos, is JavaScript-rendered and returned nothing to plain curl or WebFetch this pass; a browser-rendering pass should retry it directly and would likely upgrade all four delivered trees plus surface more. 4 trees delivered (pit_001-004), reaching the 4-tree floor.

Highest-value lead for upgrading pit_001-004 from approximate to confirmed precision and for finding the remaining ~11 of the 15 trees that met criteria in the inaugural round (44 submissions, 15 qualified, only 8 identified this pass via the minutes).
